newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shantytown goats to be fed to lions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shantytown goats to be fed to lions.

text.p: Rio de Janeiro environmental officials are rounding up goats in the city's shantytowns and plan to kill the old and sickly ones and feed them to the lions in the zoo, a city official said on Friday.
"We are taking the goats from the shantytowns because they eat the seedlings of our reforestation programme," a spokesman for the city's environmental department told Reuters.

Some of the goats wil be kept at the zoo but sickly ones will be killed and fed to the lions. He said 60 goats had already been taken from the Paulo de Medeiros shantytown in the Agua Santa suburb of Rio. Some of residents there wanted to save the goats, whose milk has been used to feed babies.
